subject: Behavioral Economics
title: The Taboo of Talking About Debt
description: Learn The Taboo of Talking About Debt in one minute.

hook.text: People discuss their sex lives more freely than their debt levels. Money shame is the last social taboo.

buildup.text: Debt carries stigma. Admitting it feels like admitting failure, even when the causes are medical bills or job loss.

discovery.text: Shame prevents help-seeking. People in debt avoid financial advisors, support groups, and even opening their mail.

twist.text: But communities that normalize debt discussion see better outcomes. Support groups for debt work.

climax.text: Breaking the taboo reduces cognitive load. Sharing the number with one trusted person makes it feel manageable and real.

punchline.text: Name your debt out loud. That's where recovery starts.

quiz.question: How does debt shame affect financial recovery?
options: Shame prevents people from seeking help, worsening the situation
Debt shame doesn't exist in most cultures
